title: 통일ㆍ북한 연구비 지급 규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:31559:20210330:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Decree on the Organization of the Ministry of Unification and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 31559, Mar. 30, 2021>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) through (3) Omitted.

(4) The Regulations on Payment of Research Expenses for Unification and North Korean Studies are partially amended as follows:

In Articles 1 and 2, "Institute for Unification Education" is replaced with "National Institute for Unification Education", respectively.

In the first sentence of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 4, Article 5 (1) and (2), Article 6, Article 7, and Article 8 (1), "President of the Institute for Unification Education" is replaced with "President of the National Institute for Unification Education", respectively.
